ShortDescription.Value: Design road signs in game and place them on gantries, posts or any surface

Publish.LongDescription:
Design road signs in game and put them on your roads.
**Designer** - Live, to-scale preview with templates for 13 countries: United States, Canada, Germany, United Kingdom, Nordic, France, Netherlands, Italy, Switzerland, Russia, Australia, Japan and China - Parts: text, route shields, arrows, lane diagrams (exits, forks, roundabouts), LED text, dividers, rows and columns, chips, full-width panels (EXIT ONLY) and exit tabs - LED message boards with dot-matrix lettering that glows at night - Fonts, colors and spacing from each country's sign style; save your own templates
**Placement** - Gantries across the road: double or single truss, curved or straight tube, span or cantilever, signs on both sides - Arrange signs over lanes, drag them, add lights - Roadside signs on posts, or just the sign as a prop on any surface or the side of an elevated road - Click a placed sign to edit, move or duplicate it
**Sharing** - Placed signs are normal objects saved with your city; the city rebuilds them on any PC with Sign Builder - Themes are plain files: make your own, or publish theme packs on Paradox Mods (template included on GitHub)
